scope.zh: 追踪与AI基础设施直接相关的开放标准、联盟与厂商互连项目：它们决定芯粒、内存、纵向/横向网络如何互联。每条标注版本日期、证据级别与未核实之处。 本轮2026-11-12仅对选定条目补证或更新；其余内容保留历史日期，完整覆盖尚未完成。
scope.en: Tracks open standards, consortia and vendor interconnect programmes that bear on AI infrastructure: how chiplets, memory and scale-up / scale-out networks connect. Each entry carries a version date, an evidence level and what was not verified. The 12 November 2026 review updates selected entries only; other content retains historical dates and complete coverage remains pending.

summary.zh: 面向AI算力池内加速器与交换机的低延迟、高带宽互连：200G每通道，单个计算池最多1,024个加速器；提供读、写与原子事务的加载/存储协议。
summary.en: Low-latency, high-bandwidth interconnect between accelerators and switches in an AI pod: 200G per lane, up to 1,024 accelerators per pod, with a load/store protocol using read, write and atomic transactions.

facts.zh: 联盟新闻稿称代表85家以上成员公司。

facts.en: The release cites 93% effective peak bandwidth as a design aim (consortium claim, not independently verified).

summary.zh: 以以太网为基础的通信栈，覆盖网卡、交换机、光模块与线缆等各层；把现代RDMA带到以太网与IP，并强调到百万级端点的端到端扩展与多厂商互操作。
summary.en: An Ethernet-based communication stack spanning NICs, switches, optics and cables; brings modern RDMA to Ethernet and IP, and stresses end-to-end scaling to millions of endpoints and multi-vendor interoperability.

facts.zh: 发布页未给出成员数量。
facts.en: The release page does not state a member count.

summary.zh: 开放芯粒互连标准：数据速率提升至48与64 GT/s（2.0为32 GT/s），适用于2D（UCIe-S）与2.5D（UCIe-A）封装；完全向后兼容；侧带距离扩展到100 mm，并增加多芯片SiP的固件管理与紧急控制。
summary.en: Open chiplet interconnect standard: data rates rise to 48 and 64 GT/s (2.0 was 32 GT/s) for 2D (UCIe-S) and 2.5D (UCIe-A) packaging; fully backward compatible; sideband reach extends to 100 mm, with firmware management and emergency controls for multi-chip SiPs.

caveat.zh: 只读取了联盟博客，未读取规范本身。
caveat.en: Only the consortium blog was read, not the specification.

hotchips.title: Packaging needs economic and test evidence.
Integration adds power, test and trust gates.

summary.zh: 开放的一致性互连：新增用于内存分层的热页监测单元（CHMU）、通用事件记录、在线固件激活，并通过可信安全协议（TSP）扩展安全；与此前所有CXL规范完全向后兼容。
summary.en: Open coherent interconnect: adds a Hot-Page Monitoring Unit (CHMU) for memory tiering, common event records, online firmware activation and extends security through the Trusted Security Protocol (TSP); fully backward compatible with all earlier CXL specifications.

caveat.zh: 3.2历史条目保留；4.0已由2025年11月18日联盟公告核实，见S10。
caveat.en: Historical 3.2 entry retained; 4.0 verified against the 18 November 2025 consortium release, see S10.

Memory placement and coherence drew sustained probing.
Memory expansion needed an access model.

summary.zh: 2048位接口，引脚速率最高8 Gb/s，单堆栈最高约2 TB/s；独立通道由16个增至32个（各含2个伪通道）；堆叠4–16层，裸片24 Gb或32 Gb；接口定义保持与HBM3控制器的向后兼容。
summary.en: 2048-bit interface, up to 8 Gb/s per pin, up to about 2 TB/s per stack; independent channels double from 16 to 32 (two pseudo-channels each); 4- to 16-high stacks of 24 Gb or 32 Gb dies; the interface keeps backward compatibility with HBM3 controllers.

summary.zh: 128 GT/s每通道原始速率，x16双向最高约512 GB/s；采用PAM4与flit编码；保持向后兼容；另有光学感知重定时器ECN。PCI-SIG路线图提到8.0（256 GT/s）计划于2028年前发布。
summary.en: 128 GT/s raw rate per lane, up to about 512 GB/s bidirectional at x16; PAM4 signalling with flit encoding; backward compatible; an Optical Aware Retimer ECN is separate. The PCI-SIG roadmap mentions 8.0 (256 GT/s) planned by 2028.

date_note.en: Latest status is from Meta’s engineering post of 12 Oct 2026; ESUN was founded at the 2025 OCP Global Summit (13 Oct 2025).

status.zh: ESUN 1.0 已于2026年发布；1.1 即将完成；SUE-T 目标2026下半年（二手）
status.en: ESUN 1.0 released in 2026; 1.1 close; SUE-T targeted 2H 2026 (secondary)

summary.zh: ESUN（以太网扩展纵向网络）是OCP网络项目中的新工作组，目标是把成熟的以太网生态改造用于AI纵向扩展域：协议头、错误处理、无损传输、以太网帧与交换层；并与UEC、IEEE对齐、避免专有绑定。Broadcom贡献的SUE规范演进为SUE-T工作组（据检索结果）。 2026年状态：Meta称“ESUN 1.0 网络运营商需求基础规范”已于今年早些时候发布，下一版 ESUN 1.1 加入交换机配置文件与缩短帧间隙等特性。
summary.en: ESUN (Ethernet for Scale-Up Networking) is a new workstream in the OCP Networking Project that adapts the mature Ethernet ecosystem to AI scale-up domains: protocol headers, error handling, lossless transfer, Ethernet framing and switching layers; it aims to align with UEC and IEEE and avoid proprietary ties. Broadcom's SUE contribution evolved into the SUE-T workstream (per search results). 2026 status: Meta says the “ESUN 1.0 Network Operator Requirements Base Specification” was released earlier this year, and the next version, ESUN 1.1, adds features such as switch profiles and inter-packet gap reduction.

facts.en: Participants named in Meta's post: AMD, Arista, Arm, Broadcom, Cisco, HPE, Marvell, Meta, Microsoft, NVIDIA, OpenAI, Oracle.

facts.zh: Meta 的 Tahan 是为 MTIA 300 训练加速器构建的以太网纵向扩展交换机：基于 Broadcom 51.2 Tbps Tomahawk 5，四台交换机以无阻塞拓扑互连16个加速器，称已在出货，并沿用其横向扩展网络的无损 RoCE 传输；未来每机架72加速器的刀片基于102.4T 芯片并将采用 ESUN 作为数据平面。
facts.en: Meta’s Tahan is an Ethernet scale-up switch built for its MTIA 300 training accelerators: based on Broadcom’s 51.2 Tbps Tomahawk 5, four switches interconnect 16 accelerators in a non-blocking topology, it is said to be shipping and reuses the lossless RoCE transport of Meta’s scale-out network; a future 72-accelerator-per-rack blade on 102.4T silicon will adopt ESUN as its data plane.

facts.zh: ESUN 1.0 的确切发布日期该文未给出；二手来源在2026年2月与3月10日之间不一致。SUE-T（传输层）目标2026下半年、五家以上超大规模厂商已在生产中使用以太网纵向扩展，均来自对 Broadcom 的二手转述，未采信为已核实。
facts.en: The post gives no exact release date for ESUN 1.0; secondary sources disagree between February and 10 March 2026. SUE-T (the transport layer) targeted for 2H 2026 and five or more hyperscalers running Ethernet scale-up in production come from secondary reports of Broadcom and are not adopted as verified.

facts.zh: 该文称 ESUN 与 IEEE 和 UEC 工作对齐；文中未提及 UALink。
facts.en: The post says ESUN coordinates with IEEE and UEC work; it does not mention UALink.

summary.en: A programme that lets partners build semi-custom AI infrastructure around NVLink; first adopters named include MediaTek, Marvell, Alchip, Astera Labs, Synopsys and Cadence; Fujitsu and Qualcomm said they plan to pair custom CPUs with NVIDIA GPUs.

summary.zh: SPHBM4（标准封装HBM4）把与处理器的连接由2,048个信号减少到512个，使HBM4级带宽可在有机基板上实现，从而可少用或不用昂贵的硅中介层，旨在降低AI存储封装成本。
summary.en: SPHBM4 (standard-package HBM4) cuts the processor connection from 2,048 signals to 512 so that HBM4-class bandwidth can be delivered on organic substrates, reducing or removing the need for an expensive silicon interposer and aiming to lower AI memory packaging cost.

facts.zh: HBM4E 未找到 JEDEC 标准：一篇博客称它是厂商产品代际；报道称 Samsung 于2026年5月29日开始提供12层HBM4E样品、Micron 预计2027年量产——均为单一二手来源。
facts.en: No JEDEC standard for HBM4E was found: one blog describes it as a vendor product generation; Samsung reportedly began shipping 12-high HBM4E samples on 29 May 2026 and Micron expects volume production in 2027, all from a single secondary source.

status.en: Draft 0.5 available to members; full release targeted for 2028

summary.zh: PCIe 8.0 草案0.5在成员对0.3草案的反馈基础上发布：目标传输速率256 GT/s，x16双向最高约1 TB/s，保持PAM4并向后兼容；PCI-SIG称完整规范仍在2028年的目标轨道上，且指向成员发布而非硬件上市。
summary.en: PCIe 8.0 Draft 0.5 followed member feedback on Draft 0.3: it targets 256 GT/s and up to about 1 TB/s bi-directional on x16, keeps PAM4 and stays backward compatible; PCI-SIG says the full specification remains on track for 2028, and that means release to members, not hardware on shelves.

note.zh: 两条开放的纵向扩展路径：专用的加载/存储互连 vs 以太网适配。
note.en: Two open scale-up paths: a dedicated load/store interconnect versus an Ethernet adaptation.
ESUN says it will align with UEC and IEEE.

note.zh: 治理方式不同：厂商合作项目 vs 开放联盟。
note.en: Different governance: a vendor partner programme versus an open consortium.

note.zh: 两者都由先进封装决定落地：芯粒互连与HBM堆叠。
note.en: Both depend on advanced packaging: chiplet links and HBM stacks.

note.zh: CXL运行在PCIe物理层之上（据CXL联盟自述的一致性互连定位，细节需读规范）。
note.en: CXL runs over the PCIe physical layer (details need the specifications).

note.zh: HBM4 与其窄接口变体 SPHBM4：同级带宽，不同封装路线。
note.en: HBM4 and its narrow-interface variant SPHBM4: the same class of bandwidth through a different packaging route.

note.en: PCIe 7.0 has been released to members; 8.0 is still a draft, targeted for 2028.
